samples.query: How many weeks of paternity leave do male employees get?
retrieved_passages: Section 3: Maternity and Paternity Leave Female employees are entitled to 26 weeks of paid maternity leave. Male employees are entitled to 2 weeks of paid paternity leave. Maternity leave must be applied for at least 8 weeks before the expected delivery date. Adoption leave of 12 weeks is available to employees who legally adopt a child under the age of 1.

Section 1: Annual Leave Employees are entitled to 20 annual paid leaves per calendar year. Unused annual leave can be carried forward to the next year for a maximum of 1 year. Annual leave must be requested at least 3 working days in advance through the HR portal. Employees who resign are paid out for unused annual leave at their final gross salary rate.

samples.query: How many work-from-home days do customer-facing employees get?
retrieved_passages: Section 2: Frequency Eligible employees may work from home up to 2 days per week. Employees in customer-facing roles may work from home up to 1 day per week only. Full-time remote work (5 days per week) requires written approval from the department head and HR director jointly.

Section 1: Eligibility Employees who have completed 6 months of continuous employment are eligible to apply for work-from-home arrangements.
